buffer_name.description: Buffer solution used for equilibration and loading.

salt_name.description: Name or identity of the salt used in the experiment.

process_identifier.description: Process identifier as stored in eLabFTW metadata.

pump_speed.description: Pump speed used during loading (instrument units).

replicates.description: Number of technical replicates for each condition.

resin_mass.description: Mass of resin used per condition.

ligand_name.description: Name or identity of the ligand (adsorbate).

total_volume.description: Total liquid volume per well or reactor.

salt_concentrations.description: List of salt concentrations used (semicolon- or comma-separated in eLabFTW).

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of equilibration cycles performed before loading.

equilibration_volume.description: Volume used in each equilibration cycle.

ligand_concentrations.description: List of ligand concentrations used (semicolon- or comma-separated in eLabFTW).

measurement_wavelength.description: Measurement wavelength of the Tecan plate reader.

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of the calibration curve relating absorbance to concentration.

salt_concentration_unit.description: Unit for salt concentrations, e.g. mM.

salt_stock_concentration.description: Concentration of the salt stock solution.

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit for ligand concentrations, e.g. mM or uM.

ligand_stock_concentration.description: Concentration of the ligand stock solution.

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of the calibration curve relating absorbance to concentration.

number_of_salt_concentrations.description: Number of different salt concentrations prepared.

number_of_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of different ligand concentrations prepared.

analysis_status.description: Status of the analysis script for this experiment.

analysis_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when analysis results were collected.

summary.description: Key metrics aggregated from analysis_results_*.json and derived files.

files_processed.description: Number of data files processed by the analysis script.

n_ligand.description: Number of ligand concentrations used in the plate layout.

n_salt.description: Number of salt concentrations used in the plate layout.

replicates.description: Number of technical replicates per condition.

metadata_from_analysis.description: Metadata block copied from analysis_results_*.json (ligand/salt concentrations, units, calibration, resin mass, total volume).

fit_results.description: Langmuir fit results per salt concentration, if available.

data_files.description: Output data files generated by the analysis pipeline.

plots.description: Plot files generated by the analysis pipeline.

warnings.description: List of warnings returned by the analysis script, if available.
